notes: P1 single-player prototype only: seven items, five recipes; remaining content stays planned.
Null numeric values require P1/P2 balancing; they are never executable recipe values.
Coal is a proposed reuse of vanilla smoker fuel and must be checked in P2.
Machine crafting inputs are provisional; Egg currently reserves the normal white egg ID, with category/large-egg support pending P1.
P1 prototype shops provide soybean/wheat at Pierre and Chinese toon at Gus year-round in limited quantities. Final crops/forage/restock rules await P2; these supplies are for the two P1 routes.
